definitions.explanation: The demand for goods and services within a country's own economy, as opposed to demand from exports. Composed of 内 (internal) + 需 (demand). A key economic term used in news, policy discussions, and business.

examples.japanese: {内需|ないじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Policies to expand domestic demand are needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}ら→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ず、{内需|ないじゅ}⟦{主導|しゅどう}→主導：11406_shudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: The aim is economic growth led by domestic demand rather than relying on exports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}{減少|げんしょう}→人口減少：24385_jinkougenshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{内需|ないじゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{縮小|しゅくしょう}→縮小：02568_shukushou⟧し、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As domestic demand shrinks due to population decline, many companies are expanding into overseas markets.

notes:
USAGE:
{内需|ないじゅ} is an economics term that appears frequently in news articles, government reports, and business discussions. It is the opposite of ⟦{外需|がいじゅ}→外需：12644_gaiju⟧ (external demand / export demand).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内需|ないじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (expand domestic demand)
- {内需|ないじゅ}⟦{主導|しゅどう}→主導：11406_shudou⟧ (domestic-demand-led)
- {内需|ないじゅ}⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧ (domestic-demand-related stocks)
- {内需|ないじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低迷|ていめい}→低迷：09332_teimei⟧ (sluggish domestic demand)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{外需|がいじゅ}→外需：12644_gaiju⟧ means "external demand" — demand driven by exports. ⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧ means "demand" in general and is the broader term.
